summary: Fractal web, embedded workspaces and Storybook ship only English React Aria strings rather than every locale; roster, focus, collection, virtualizer and drag-and-drop code remain synchronous.

compatibility.detail: Product approved en-US-only React Aria support until the app has real i18n. Explicit root I18nProviders select English strings, plurals, Aria number/date formats and left-to-right reading direction even when the browser prefers another locale. Native Intl/Date timestamp formatting outside React Aria is unchanged. No API or wire change.

downtime.detail: Takes effect with the next web build; no daemon restart is required.

recovery.detail: To add real app i18n, expand the shared locale list in apps/fractal-web/scripts/aria-locales.mjs together with all root I18nProviders and their locale-selection UI; test every supported locale. Revert this change and rebuild to restore navigator-selected React Aria locale behavior and all bundled translations.
